result.meaning: Whether kea-dhcp4 -t exited zero. A nonzero tool exit returns false as a successful observation, not a stop refusal.

mutationPerformed.meaning: Present on a stop refusal; no mutation occurred.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class if the shared front door had to report an unhandled exception.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed outcomes are listed below; none means the validation command returned. The stop also returns command failed: <argv>: <error> when the command cannot run.
